_comment: Auto-updated daily by GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/update-jobs.yml). Do not edit manually.

jobs.title: Theatre Nurse
jobs.description: Aga Khan Hospital Uganda seeks a skilled Theatre Nurse to assist surgical teams in elective and emergency operating theatres, maintaining the highest standards of sterile technique and patient safety.
responsibilities: Scrub and circulate for elective and emergency surgical procedures.
Maintain sterile field and instrument counts throughout all operations.
Prepare and check theatre equipment, implants and consumables.
Provide pre- and post-operative patient assessment and handover.
requirements: Registered nurse with at least 2 years of scrub/theatre experience
Recognised post-basic theatre nursing certificate is an advantage
UNMC registration in good standing
Ability to work on-call rotas
jobs.employerDescription: Aga Khan Hospital Uganda is a private, not-for-profit facility in Kampala providing specialist care. It is part of the Aga Khan Health Services network operating across East Africa.

jobs.title: Band 5 Staff Nurse – General Medicine
jobs.description: NHS Trust Manchester is recruiting international nurses at Band 5 with UK visa sponsorship under the NHS Overseas Sponsorship Pathway.
responsibilities: Deliver evidence-based nursing care on a busy general medicine ward.
Assess, plan, implement and evaluate individualised care for adult patients.
Administer medicines in line with NMC standards and Trust policy.
Supervise healthcare assistants and nursing students during shifts.
requirements: Registered nurse — NMC registration required (CBT/OSCE support available)
English language: IELTS 7.0 or OET Grade B
Willingness to relocate to the UK
Clean professional disciplinary record
jobs.employerDescription: NHS Trusts across Manchester recruit internationally trained nurses with visa sponsorship under the Health and Care Worker visa. Relocation support and structured induction are provided.

jobs.title: Graduate Nurse Program
jobs.description: Mulago National Referral Hospital's structured graduate nurse programme offers newly qualified nurses a supervised pathway into clinical practice across medical, surgical and critical care wards.
responsibilities: Deliver safe, evidence-based nursing care under supervision of a senior nurse.
Complete structured rotations across medical, surgical and maternal wards.
Maintain accurate patient records and handover documentation.
Participate in ward meetings, continuing education and quality audits.
requirements: Diploma or Bachelor of Nursing (Science) from a recognised Ugandan institution
Valid or pending Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC) registration
Completion of internship or equivalent supervised practice
Strong clinical communication and teamwork skills
jobs.employerDescription: Mulago National Referral Hospital is Uganda's largest public hospital and a teaching centre for Makerere University. It recruits nurses across all clinical specialities.

jobs.title: ICU / Critical Care Nurse
jobs.description: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) Uganda is seeking experienced ICU nurses for its critical care teams in Kampala.
responsibilities: Manage haemodynamically unstable patients in the ICU/HDU.
Operate mechanical ventilators, infusion pumps and monitoring equipment.
Lead and mentor national nursing staff in critical care protocols.
Contribute to MSF medical data collection and incident reporting.
requirements: Registered nurse with at least 2 years dedicated ICU/HDU experience
UNMC or equivalent international registration
Post-basic critical care certification preferred
Experience in resource-limited or humanitarian settings is an asset
jobs.employerDescription: MSF runs emergency medical projects across Uganda, providing critical care, maternal health and outbreak response services.

jobs.title: Nursing Consultant – Africa Region
jobs.description: WHO is engaging a Nursing Consultant to support nursing workforce strategies and competency frameworks for Member States in the African Region.
responsibilities: Review nursing workforce data and prepare gap analysis reports.
Develop or adapt clinical competency frameworks for the African context.
Facilitate stakeholder consultations with Member State nursing councils.
Draft policy briefs and technical guidance for WHO publication.
requirements: Masters or higher degree in Nursing or Public Health
Minimum 10 years experience including policy, research or advisory roles
Published work or technical reports in nursing workforce or health systems
Ability to work independently and meet strict WHO deliverables
jobs.employerDescription: WHO posts nursing and health workforce consultancy contracts through careers.who.int. Consultants work with regional offices, country offices and headquarter technical departments.

jobs.title: Community Health Nurse
jobs.description: UNHCR Uganda is recruiting a Community Health Nurse to strengthen primary healthcare delivery in refugee settlements in the West Nile region.
responsibilities: Conduct community health assessments and plan outreach interventions.
Train and supervise community health workers and refugee volunteers.
Collect, analyse and report health data to UNHCR programme managers.
Coordinate with Ministry of Health and partner NGOs on referrals.
requirements: Diploma or Degree in Nursing/Midwifery with community health experience
Minimum 2 years experience in refugee, humanitarian or rural settings
Strong data collection and report-writing skills
Willingness to be based in Arua / West Nile region
jobs.employerDescription: UNHCR Uganda operates across refugee settlements providing protection and health services to over 1.5 million refugees.

jobs.title: Midwife – District Health Facility
jobs.description: The Ministry of Health Uganda is recruiting qualified midwives for district health facilities in the Mbarara region.
responsibilities: Provide skilled attendance at normal deliveries and manage obstetric emergencies.
Conduct antenatal and postnatal clinics and family planning services.
Maintain maternal and newborn registers and submit monthly reports.
Mentor student midwives and junior staff on placement.
requirements: Certificate or Diploma in Midwifery from a recognised institution
Valid UNMC registration as a midwife
Willingness to work in rural/district health facilities
Knowledge of BEmONC is an advantage
jobs.employerDescription: The Ministry of Health Uganda manages over 5,000 health facilities. It recruits midwives and nurses for government health centres, district hospitals and regional referral hospitals.

jobs.title: Mental Health Outreach Nurse
jobs.description: StrongMinds Uganda is hiring a Mental Health Outreach Nurse to facilitate group therapy sessions and community mental health outreach in the Mbale region.
responsibilities: Facilitate group interpersonal therapy (IPT-G) sessions for women with depression.
Train and supervise community volunteers in mental health first aid.
Conduct baseline and follow-up assessments using validated screening tools.
Compile monthly programme data and contribute to learning reports.
requirements: Diploma or Degree in Psychiatric/Mental Health Nursing or General Nursing with mental health experience
Familiarity with group therapy facilitation or community counselling
Fluency in Lugisu or Lumasaaba is a strong advantage
Ability to ride a motorcycle (preferred)
jobs.employerDescription: StrongMinds Uganda delivers scalable community-based mental health programmes across East Africa through a proven group therapy model.

jobs.title: Nursing Surveillance Officer
jobs.description: WHO Uganda Country Office is recruiting a Nursing Surveillance Officer to support integrated disease surveillance and health system strengthening.
responsibilities: Coordinate national nursing surveillance activities with MOH and district teams.
Analyse disease notification data and prepare situation reports.
Support capacity-building workshops for district health workers.
Liaise with regional WHO and global health security networks.
requirements: Bachelor of Nursing Science and postgraduate qualification in public/community health
Minimum 5 years in public health surveillance or epidemiology
Excellent analytical and report-writing skills
Experience with WHO/UN systems is an advantage
jobs.employerDescription: WHO Uganda Country Office supports the Government of Uganda in achieving universal health coverage, disease outbreak response and health workforce development.

jobs.title: Field Nurse – Humanitarian Response
jobs.description: A ReliefWeb-listed humanitarian NGO seeks experienced Field Nurses to support emergency health response in South Sudan.
responsibilities: Provide triage, primary healthcare and emergency nursing in mobile clinic settings.
Train and support national staff and community health volunteers.
Report health data and critical incidents to the programme coordinator.
Operate within strict humanitarian principles and security protocols.
requirements: Registered nurse with at least 3 years clinical experience
Prior humanitarian or field experience strongly preferred
Current First Aid / BTLS or equivalent certification
Flexibility to work in challenging field conditions
jobs.employerDescription: ReliefWeb aggregates humanitarian job listings from NGOs including IMC, IRC, Medair, Concern Worldwide and other international partners.
